chunks.subject: AP African American Studies
chunks.title: SAQ Q3 (Non-Stimulus / No Source) — Scoring (3 points, parts A–C)
chunks.content: AP African American Studies Short-Answer Q3 (no stimulus / no source), 3 points — parts A, B, C each worth 1 point, earned INDEPENDENTLY, answered from disciplinary content knowledge. Tasks combine DESCRIBE (relevant characteristics of a specified topic, more than naming a term) and EXPLAIN (how/why a development occurs or a relationship exists). A part earns its point only when defensible, accurate, and responsive to the sub-prompt; naming a term without describing it or giving off-topic/inaccurate content does not earn it.

chunks.content: SAQ Q3 (no stimulus) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). All parts complete their describe/explain tasks with accurate, responsive content.

chunks.title: SAQ Q3 exemplar — Sample 3B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ Q3 scored 2/3 (A 1, B 1, C 0). Parts A and B earn credit; Part C fails to complete its task with defensible, responsive content.

chunks.title: SAQ Q3 exemplar — Sample 3C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ Q3 scored 1/3 (A 0, B 1, C 0). Only Part B earns credit; A and C do not complete their tasks with accurate content. Points are independent.
